about: The Circles' scenery (content/circles props, ambience depth and life): painted sprites instead of the built-in shapes (StageTrack.PropShapes, AmbienceSprites). One sprite per entry; the size comes from the entry.
name: Scenery

ewSpires.png.prompt: Paint a single cluster of tall jagged spires of black basalt and cooled slag, faint orange lava light along their edges. Seen from the side, centered, the whole thing visible, with plenty of empty background around it on every side. Painterly dark fantasy matte painting: soft brush strokes, detailed, gritty, hazy with distance. Only this one piece of scenery: no figures, no people, no creatures, no ground, no sky. Plain flat pure magenta background (#ff00ff) all around it.
